suggests.title: Refer to Rapid Access Chest Pain Clinic
suggests.rationale: Exertional chest pain without red flags meets local RACPC referral criteria.

suggests.title: Seek cardiology advice & guidance
suggests.rationale: Where diagnosis is uncertain, A&G may avoid an outpatient appointment.

suggests.title: 12-lead ECG before referral
suggests.rationale: Receiving services expect a recent ECG with palpitation referrals.

suggests.title: Primary-care review of triggers and bloods
suggests.rationale: Benign palpitations with normal baseline tests can often be managed in primary care.

suggests.title: Community ambulatory ECG monitoring
suggests.rationale: Intermittent symptoms may be captured with ambulatory monitoring.
